PROFILE_REQUIRED: Complete a supported profile and accept a plan first.
SESSION_ACTIVE: The active prescription stays pinned. End the session before changing the next plan.
POLICY_NOT_APPROVED: Production guidance needs a reviewed policy bundle.
REQUIRED_WORK_DOES_NOT_FIT: Required work does not fit in that time. Reschedule; rest and warm-up are not compressed.
ALREADY_FITS: The existing session fits the time budget.
OPTIONAL_WORK_REMOVED: Omit optional work for this session only. Rest and warm-up remain unchanged.
NO_ELIGIBLE_SUBSTITUTE: No enabled directional substitute matches your equipment and exclusions.
CURATED_SUBSTITUTION: Use \(alt.name) for this session only. Confirm its own load and equipment; the original load is not transferred.
USER_RESCHEDULE: Move this session without doubling work or changing the sequence.
REPORTED_PAIN: Guidance for this activity is paused because you reported pain. A different exercise is not assumed safe.
EXERCISE_EXCLUDED: Your explicit exclusion takes priority over progression or preferences.
UNREVIEWED_EXERCISE: This exercise has no enabled guidance policy.
SESSION_OVERRIDE_ACTIVE: Finish or discard the temporary session change before progression.
LOADING_POLICY_UNAVAILABLE: Machine settings and assistance need equipment-specific reviewed progression.
BASELINE_REQUIRED: Confirm a familiar working load. The app does not estimate your strength.
HISTORY_STALE: Reconfirm your baseline before using older performance.
MODIFIED_EXPOSURE: A shortened or substituted session does not qualify as an original exposure.
EVIDENCE_CONFLICT: Resolve the conflicting set before progression.
INCOMPLETE_EXPOSURE: One or more designated working sets are missing; this is not a strength-failure diagnosis.
LOAD_CONTEXT_CHANGED: The recorded load differs from the planned baseline. Confirm the baseline rather than transferring evidence.
EFFORT_UNKNOWN: Required effort is unknown. No effort-dependent increase is proposed.
TARGET_NOT_QUALIFIED: Repeat or review the plan. The configured rep or effort criterion is not met.
REPEAT_TARGET: Keep the current rep targets and load.
NEXT_TARGET_REP: Propose one additional total target rep; load and working-set count stay unchanged.
MORE_EXPOSURES_REQUIRED: The required consecutive comparable exposures are not complete.
EQUIPMENT_STEP_UNKNOWN: Confirm the available equipment loads. No increment is invented.
INCREMENT_EXCEEDS_BOUND: The next available load exceeds this policy's permitted change. Keep the load.
QUALIFYING_EXPOSURES_COMPLETE: Both qualifying exposures met the rep and reported-effort criteria. Review the next available load; sets do not increase.
ADHERENCE_REPLAN: You have been completing fewer sessions than this week plans. A week that fits what you have been doing keeps your weekly work.
FOLLOWING_THE_PLAN: You are completing the planned sessions. The week stays as it is.
REPLAN_NEEDS_HISTORY: This week is too new to judge. It is reviewed after two full weeks of training.
NO_BETTER_WEEK: No week fits your recent sessions better than the current one.
REPLAN_UNAVAILABLE: This content has no weekly planner, so the week cannot be adapted.
SHORTER_SESSIONS_REPLAN: Several sessions ended early for lack of time. A week with shorter sessions keeps your weekly work.
MORE_SESSIONS_REPLAN: You have been training more often than this week plans. A week that includes those sessions plans them properly.
TRAINING_DAYS_REPLAN: You have mostly trained on other days than this week uses. A week on your days fits better.
STATUS_PAUSED: Suggestions are paused while you are on a break, sick or injured. Tap I'm back to resume them.
NEW_FREE_DAYS: A week for your new free days. Loads you confirmed carry over. Nothing changes until you accept.
DAYS_REQUIRED: Choose at least one free day.
SAME_DAYS: Those are already your free days and minutes, so the week stays.
NO_WEEK_FOR_DAYS: No week fits those days and minutes. Add a day or more minutes.
WEEK_OPTION_MISSING: That week is no longer offered for these days. Choose from the new options.
